title: How Will You Measure Your Life

questions.q: Why do we neglect our closest relationships?
a: Work rewards you now and loved ones rarely ask
Relationships cost more money than work does
Family members prefer to be left alone
Work is simply more enjoyable than family
questions.why: Lesson 1 says work pays off right away while strong relationships ask little of us.

questions.q: What question does the summary recommend asking about a relationship?
a: What job does this person need me to do?
What have I done for this person lately?
How can I change this person's behavior?
Why does this person demand so much?
questions.why: Lesson 2 calls this the single best question for improving any relationship.

questions.q: What does treating family life like a job accomplish?
a: It builds intuition and empathy for their needs
It turns relationships into obligations
It makes you treat family like coworkers
It encourages you to work longer hours
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the question flips your perspective and helps you sense what others need.

a: Seeing only the edges of a situation
Planning every decision in advance
Ignoring small costs completely
Weighing all costs equally
questions.why: Lesson 3 defines it as focusing on the edges rather than the full picture.

questions.q: What happened to Blockbuster in the summary's example?
a: It went bankrupt after ignoring a new service
It bought Netflix and grew rapidly
It was saved by a government bailout
It switched from rentals to making films
questions.why: Lesson 3 says Blockbuster avoided the marginal cost of change and went bankrupt in 2010.
